title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 SERVFAIL Response Verification
verification_method: Focused loopback tests, requirement-home trace tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene for SERVFAIL response pass-through behavior.
scope: This verification covers handler-provided SERVFAIL DNS response pass-through to the client. It does not verify resolver policy for when to emit SERVFAIL, nor transport-level error mapping.
preconditions: The DoQ foundation and minimal stream lifecycle slices exist.
The local managed QUIC loopback support is available for response pass-through tests.
expected_result: The focused DoQ stream lifecycle and RFC 9250 requirement-home tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9250 artifacts, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The DoQ adapter now proves SERVFAIL response pass-through over real QUIC loopback. Remaining RFC 9250 padding, AXFR/IXFR, 0-RTT, Retry/address-validation, gateway rewriting, and interop work remains future trace-owned scope.
